column2: Laboratory brain-to-brain interfaces are real and unglamorous — electrodes, wires and a magnetic coil, moving roughly one bit at a time. The page keeps that documented floor separate from the alleged operational ceiling, which is where the handler question actually lives.

The claim that Charlie turned down money that would have tied Turning Point tighter to pro-war positions, and broke with donors roughly 48 hours before he was killed. It reaches the public through televised retellings and screenshots rather than authenticated filings, which is exactly what discovery would test.

A former counterterrorism director's remarks, and the far louder headline built on top of them. The narrow, checkable part is that Kent says foreign-involvement leads deserved scrutiny and that an offer to pursue them was reportedly rebuffed; the "murderous cartel" phrasing belongs to the poster, not to Kent.

The dated record: 2019 against endless wars, April 2025 calling a new Middle East war a catastrophic mistake, June 2025 calling regime change pathologically insane. It matters because it shows the anti-war stance was years old, not a convenient posthumous invention.

The Iran-tagged packaging of the exploding-mic theory — that the fatal mechanism was a device in the microphone rather than a distant rifle. The forensic core lives in the Microphone section; this page records how the claim travelled under a "Mossad Files" label, and what skeptics answer.

Iran had nothing to do with killing Charlie Kirk. This section maps the reverse: that by reportedly lobbying against a U.S.–Iran war he ended up opposite that war's most powerful advocates — a policy motive the lone-gunman account never addresses.

The most repeated argument in this section is a calendar argument: killed between two Iran escalations, with the war advancing afterwards. The page states it plainly and then states its limit — timing is suggestive, never probative.

Joe Kent describing, in his own words, how he believes Iran policy actually got set: an echo chamber around the president that his interviewer calls Truman Show–esque. Kent alleges no crime and never mentions Charlie Kirk, which is what makes it usable.

Both lanes on one page: the viral claims tying Kirk's Iran stance to his death, and the rebuttals — the court evidence, the skeptic pushback, and the note that hostile networks amplified the same theories. Virality is not organic proof.

The outside auditor said to have closed a Turning Point audit on June 20, 2025, weeks before the assassination. One commentator reads that timing as significant; the firm and TPUSA's attorney maintain the financials are clean, and both positions sit on the page.

A lawful global consultancy that touches the case twice: on the resume of a senior intelligence official, and through reported Gaza-related work. Adjacency is not participation, and the page says so in its own caution box.

The largest dollar figure in the citizen-investigator compilations: an allegation that TPUSA's "Resource One" printing vendor is a trade name for a roughly $700M direct-mail group. TPUSA's attorney rejects that reading, saying the organization complied with tax law.

A reported co-organizer of the July 31, 2025 Israel-and-MAGA meeting that Charlie Kirk and TPUSA were not part of. Documented as pre-event political map rather than as an accused party — correlation is not coordination.

One of two entities named in an unverified compilation alleging a TPUSA advancement director received money on top of a salary for the same job. It is recorded so an audit can confirm or retire it; no court record shows any improper payment.

A corporate catalog inside an assassination file, because the money map is one of the few motive threads testable against public records. Entries are rated openly — documented state filings at one end, single-post rumors at the other.

A Wyoming LLC created in May 2023 that reportedly owned a life-insurance policy on Charlie Kirk, with TPUSA said to have paid a roughly $350,000 loan attached to it. Key-person policies are routine and lawful; the question is who owned it, who benefits, and why the timing.

Included precisely because it is thin. An AI-assisted rumor links the company to the accused's family and speculates about UVU tent work; no documented contract has been found, and no family member is charged with anything.

Five for-profit companies at the edges of the case: a direct-mail vendor, the outside auditor, a board overlap, the broadcaster, and a consultancy. Every entry is attributed and disputed, and doing business with a nonprofit is lawful.

The broadcaster that carried The Charlie Kirk Show. A Brad Parscale FARA filing dated eight days after the assassination reportedly covered Israeli-government messaging routed into Salem properties. Filing under FARA is the lawful act; the interval is what gets noticed.

A private technology company whose board reportedly seats Erika Kirk's mother beside a Turning Point Action executive. The claim that TP Action money moved into it is unverified, and board service is lawful.

The campus-chapter, donor and media machine Kirk built — and why its internal politics matter to a murder case. Friction between donor-aligned advocacy and his late-2025 turn is documented as context, not as an accusation against any organization.

Named by a citizen investigator inside the same direct-mail money trail as "Resource One". No court record establishes an improper payment; the entry exists so a vendor ledger can confirm or retire it.

A Brad Parscale company whose FARA registration is dated September 18, 2025 — eight days after the assassination — reportedly covering Israeli-government messaging inside Salem Media. A FARA filing is a lawful disclosure, not evidence of a crime.

Reportedly dissolved in 2022, yet named as the recipient of a roughly $999,000 TPUSA "research project" payment with no public deliverables. One investigator's reading of the filings, and exactly the line item an audit would settle.

The paving contractor named for the UVU tent area, at the center of the disputed rapid re-paving of the ground where Charlie stood. Contractors execute work orders; the open question is who ordered this one, and when.

The defense contractor that operates N1098L, a Bombardier Global 6500 described as flying intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance missions for the U.S. Army. Its aircraft sits on the scrutinized timeline; no role in the events is established.

One of the entities a citizen investigator says paid a salaried TPUSA advancement director for the same fundraising job, in a compilation totalling $2.7M or more. Recorded as questions for an audit, not as established fraud.

The Lehi, Utah LLC behind a private jet that flight-trackers say left Provo Municipal about an hour after the shooting, on a path described as anomalous. Owning a jet is lawful and departures have innocent explanations.

Recorded because it is weak, not because it is strong: a shared registered agent and a St. George address said to touch the accused's family. No family member is charged, and nothing links the filing to the assassination.

The corporate name behind Integrity Security Solutions, the vendor discussed in Charlie's protective arrangements. This page fixes the LLC and the DBA so records requests are precise; the security analysis lives elsewhere.

A donor foundation's aviation entity, owning a Cessna Citation XLS that appears on the tracking boards around the case window. The foundation reportedly lists TPUSA as a key partner; giving to a charity is lawful and public.

A pro-Israel advocacy group reported as a co-sponsor of the July 31 White House session held without Kirk or TPUSA. Documented as part of the pre-event political map; no public transcript verifies every attendee.

A 501(c)(3) barred from political work, run by the same executive who runs the political arm, and funded almost entirely by an $8.6M transfer from TPUSA. That is one commentator's reading; TPUSA's attorney says the filings complied with tax law.

A Houston charity logged for one reason: a surname that recurs in the investigation. Nothing connects it to TPUSA or to the assassination — it is written down so the coincidence can be checked and retired.

A major think tank touching the case at three unrelated edges: an internship, a donor's exit over Tucker Carlson, and donors shared with TPUSA. Presence on a donor map is not participation in anything.

The four Turning Point entities, the PAC, and the donor foundations around them, mapped so the c3-versus-c4 argument can actually be followed. Financial concerns are attributed allegations, and TPUSA's rebuttal sits on every page.

The 501(c)(4) permitted to do politics, whose budget reportedly jumped $16.5M in a year while its Schedule C listed about three percent political spending. One commentator calls that an inconsistency; TPUSA's attorney says there is no proof of misreporting.
The entity that holds the investments — a structure even critics call sensible. It is here for the "missing 990s" claim and for the rebuttal that all four were filed by May 2025.

The one entity fully allowed to spend on politics, which is why it anchors the entire reporting argument. The dispute is not that political money exists, but whether some of it ran through the wrong entity.

The flagship charity Charlie founded, and the organization every financial question orbits. Commentators allege the inter-entity grants and post-death fundraising deserve scrutiny; attorney Robert Barnes says the filings complied with tax law and no regulator has found otherwise.

A conservative donor foundation that reportedly lists Turning Point USA as a key partner and has funded it for years. Donor pressure is a recurring motive theme, but funding a charity is not evidence of anything improper.

A pro-Israel Christian advocacy group named as a co-organizer of the July 31 session and cited throughout the donor-pressure timelines. Documented as one node in a funding network; nothing here alleges that any employee acted unlawfully.

Years of campus protest and faculty objection are established public record — and are not an accusation. The page draws the line investigators insist on: ideological opponents are not assassins without direct evidence.

Three pressure lanes around Kirk in 2025: donor-class Israel alignment, an America First audience pulling the other way, and institutional GOP positioning. It also records the vancekirk2028 domain speculation, with its lack of proof stated plainly.

Structure, leadership, staffing and event operations, laid out so claims about the organization can be checked against how it actually ran. It separates documented structure from speculation instead of merging the two.

The absence question on its own: what "absent" means across the sources, why the scale mismatch struck commentators, and how the date clusters with what followed in August and September. Correlation, stated as correlation.

Charlie was both the featured speaker and the organizational principal at UVU, which is why TPUSA cameras, drones and private security contracts draw scrutiny. Founder context, not an accusation against the organization he built.

The documented federal response: an investigation opened the same day, a posthumous Presidential Medal of Freedom on what would have been his 32nd birthday, and a promise to leave no stone unturned. Public-record items, set against later questions about scope.
In August 2025 Apple Podcasts listed 752 episodes recorded while Charlie was alive. Today it lists none of them, and every one of the 1,793 missing episodes comes from the living catalog.

Every missing title, with dates, running times and Apple's own episode IDs, built from 467 Wayback captures measured against Apple's live catalog. The receipts behind the count, so nobody has to take the number on trust.

A 26-second stage clip in which the speaker, identified by the posters as a Turning Point executive, describes an aide as Charlie's "assistant and handler." The page records that the word was said, and claims nothing beyond it.

What the September 2, 2025 memo reportedly ordered: a broad efficiency and financial review going well past routine accounting, eight days before the assassination. Ordering an audit is prudent and normal; the timing is why it is here.

The org chart as a reading list — founder, post-death leadership, executives, board, and the advancement figures named in the financial reporting. Everyone named is living and presumed innocent, and the connections are organizational.

One question, checked rather than repeated: are the episodes Charlie hosted before September 10 reachable on Spotify and Apple today? The answer is given platform by platform, with dated proof links instead of restated claims.

September 3 to 9, 2025, reported hour by reported hour: the Epstein files demand, the public Israel signal, the confrontational meeting, and two UVU warning attempts nobody acted on. Context, the page insists first, is not culpability.
The day in one table — a 7:08 a.m. Egyptian Air Force departure from Provo, two low passes by an Army ISR jet, and the minutes the outlets still cannot agree on.

The government's rooftop rifle account set beside the acoustic, tent and drone objections, with the sealed autopsy and ballistics reports marked where the public record simply stops. Citizen investigation on X favours an explosive device.

Four cross-cutting essays distilled out of the old legacy write-ups — the week before, the day itself, the technical fight, and the political wake. Read it when you want the argument without the boilerplate.

The pre-event index — the meetings, warnings and reported search activity investigators place in the weeks before Utah Valley University. It gathers the questions; the Before section carries the detail.
Every chronology in the case converges on 12:23 p.m. on September 10, 2025. This is the index to them, kept deliberately separate from the parallel timeline of the court proceedings.

The bureau index — case classification, evidence handling, and the scope questions raised in public commentary about the federal investigation. It routes to the full FBI section rather than repeating it.
The loose-threads index: evidence that fits no other category and, in many cases, never entered the state's court case at all. Kept because discarded threads are where unanswered questions collect.
The post-event index: how fast the scene, the evidence and the public account of September 10 were reshaped afterwards. Every claim on it is flagged as unproven commentary before it is stated.

The organisation index, read from an unusual angle: its founder was killed at one of its own campus events, and its conduct since is measured against both the cause-of-death record and a prosecution that is charged but not proven.
The foreign-connection index. It notes plainly that the state has charged one man, and that the proceedings against him have never addressed the foreign-intelligence questions gathered here.

The weighting page: which factors actually matter. It starts from the mechanism, because citizen investigation has concluded by wide margin that an explosive device was used, and scores everything else against that.
The footage index. Frame-by-frame review of these videos is the single largest reason citizen investigators concluded an explosive, rather than a rifle round, killed Charlie Kirk.
The still-imagery index — one of the few evidence sets the public can inspect for itself while the prosecution proceeds behind sealed filings.
Every location the case touches in one index: venue, rooftop, stairs, parking, airport. The venue map is central to the state's case too, which is why these pages get read from both directions.
Maps and geographic visualisations of the UVU site and the routes around it — the index that points at the drawn evidence rather than the written argument.

The agency index: what public commentary asks about CIA involvement, and what it cannot show. Nothing here establishes that any officer or agency did anything — the questions are written down so they can be answered.

Drone activity around the UVU courtyard, indexed. Any airborne theory has to answer the same question the rest of the site works on, and the majority citizen reading favours an explosive device at the podium.
Specific-location analysis for the amphitheatre where Charlie Kirk was killed — geography studied for what it implies about the explosive-device account of the killing.
The medical index. Charlie Kirk was killed in front of thousands of witnesses and the medical record remains largely sealed, which is the one fact this page exists to keep in view.
The Topics3 entry point for the man himself — the reported "they are going to kill me" texts, the meetings that preceded them, and the financial questions about who benefited.
